ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "documentNumber": payload.documentNumber, "documentType": payload.documentType as String }

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json import modules::GlobalFunctions as global --- { nombres: vars.initialPayload.names, apellido: vars.initialPayload.firstLastName, segundo_apellido: vars.initialPayload.secondLastName, fecha_exp: global::formatDate(vars.initialPayload.dateExpedition), num_doc: vars.initialPayload.documentNumber, tipo_doc: vars.initialPayload.documentType, fecha_consulta: global::formatDate(now() >> "UTC-05:00" as TimeZone), estado: "NO VIGENTE", causal: vars.rsLisim.cause default vars.rsLisim.message default "" }

%dw 2.0 output application/json import modules::GlobalFunctions as global var additionalDate = vars.getIdentityResponse.result[0].fecha_exp default null --- { "fecha_consulta": global::formatDate(now() >> "UTC-05:00" as TimeZone), "fecha_exp": global::formatDate(additionalDate), "causal": vars.rsLisim.cause default vars.rsLisim.message default "", }

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "documentType": vars.initialPayload.documentType as String, "documentNumber": vars.initialPayload.documentNumber }

os:store.doc:name: store validation values
os:store.os:value: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { identityId: vars.rsLisim.id, documentNumber: vars.initialPayload.documentNumber, documentType: vars.initialPayload.documentType, technology: vars.initialPayload.model.technology, segment: vars.initialPayload.model.segment }]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { code: "200", message: vars.rsLisim.cause default vars.rsLisim.message default "validacion exitosa", result: { "id": vars.rsLisim.id default "", "type": vars.rsLisim."type" default "", "questions": vars.rsLisim.questions default "", "otpCode": vars.rsLisim.otpCode default "", "matchType": vars.rsLisim.matchType default "" } }
